text: Kafr al-Awamid, also spelled Kafr al-Awameed (Arabic: كفر العواميد), is a village located in the Al-Zabadani District of the Rif Dimashq Governorate in Syria. As recorded by the Syria Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS), the village had a population of 1,588 during the 2004 census.
